T: Feudal Japan. No pizza. Big problem.
D: The turtles travel back in time to feudal Japan to rescue April.
P: Serve the mains when the turtles realise there's no pizza in 1603.
S: the samurai villages of feudal Japan
Sushi rice shaped into triangles around salted salmon, wrapped in strips of nori, with pickled ginger.
the turtles stuck in old Japan
Chicken thigh pieces threaded onto skewers, grilled and basted with soy, mirin and sugar simmered down until sticky, scattered with spring onion.

Pizza dough rolled up with tomato sauce, mozzarella, pepperoni and oregano, sliced into spirals and baked golden and bubbling. Roll 500g pizza dough into a 30 x 40cm rectangle. Spread with 4 tbsp pizza sauce, then scatter with 150g grated mozzarella, 100g chopped pepperoni and 1 tsp dried oregano. Roll up tightly from the long side and cut into 12 slices. Lay cut side up in a lined tin, brush with olive oil and bake at 200C for 20 minutes until golden. Serve warm with extra sauce.
M: Back home mushroom and capsicum pizza
getting back to New York and real pizza

Pizza dough with tomato sauce, mozzarella, mushroom and capsicum, baked at 250C for 10 minutes. Stretch pizza dough thin on a floured tray. Spread with pizza sauce, then scatter with grated mozzarella, sliced mushrooms and green capsicum. Bake at 250C for 10 minutes until bubbling and crisp. Cut into slices and celebrate being back home.
the villagers who shelter the turtles

Ramen noodles in a rich miso and pork broth, topped with sliced pork belly, a jammy egg, sweet corn, spring onion and nori. Simmer 1L chicken stock with 2 tbsp grated ginger and 2 garlic cloves for 10 minutes, then whisk in 4 tbsp white miso and 1 tbsp soy. Boil 4 eggs for 6.5 minutes, cool in iced water and peel. Slice 400g cooked pork belly and sear until crisp. Cook 4 portions ramen noodles. Divide into bowls, ladle over the broth and top with pork, halved eggs, corn, spring onion and nori strips.
W: Glutinous rice flour dough wrapped around scoops of mango and vanilla ice cream, frozen until firm.
K: Iced honey barley tea with lemon
the turtles travel back in time

Toasty Japanese barley tea cold-brewed overnight, sweetened with honey and poured over ice with lemon slices, the taste of a Japanese summer. Put 4 barley tea bags in a jug with 1.5L cold water and leave in the fridge for at least 3 hours, or overnight. Remove the bags. Warm 3 tbsp honey with 3 tbsp hot water until runny and stir into the tea with the juice of half a lemon. Pour into 4 glasses filled with ice and add a lemon slice to each.

s.note: the samurai villages of feudal Japan
s.how: Cook 2 cups sushi rice and season lightly. Salt and grill 200g salmon, then flake. Wet your hands and shape rice into triangles around a little salmon. Wrap the base in a strip of nori, sprinkle with sesame and serve with pickled ginger.

s.note: the turtles stuck in old Japan
s.how: Simmer 4 tbsp soy sauce, 4 tbsp mirin and 2 tbsp sugar until syrupy. Thread 600g chicken thigh pieces onto skewers and grill, brushing with the glaze, until sticky and charred. Scatter with sliced spring onion and serve hot.

m.n: Back home mushroom and capsicum pizza
m.note: getting back to New York and real pizza
m.how: Stretch pizza dough thin on a floured tray. Spread with pizza sauce, then scatter with grated mozzarella, sliced mushrooms and green capsicum. Bake at 250C for 10 minutes until bubbling and crisp. Cut into slices and celebrate being back home.

w.how: Mix 150g glutinous rice flour, 60g sugar and 200ml water and microwave in bursts, stirring, until thick and stretchy. Roll out on cornflour and cut into rounds. Wrap each around a small frozen scoop of vanilla ice cream or mango sorbet. Freeze until firm.
